name: LTX-2.3 Image + Audio to Video
description: The official Comfy-Org LTX-2.3 image-audio-to-video graph: a first frame and a take you supply become video lip-synced to it. The clip is encoded into the audio latent and masked so the sampler keeps it, which is what makes the model draw a picture that fits the sound. Length comes from the duration you set: duration x fps + 1 frame, with the clip trimmed to the same window.

params.label: Audio
params.description: The take to lip-sync to. Drag one in from the results, or drop a file.

params.label: Negative
params.default: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly

params.label: Duration (s)
params.description: How much of the clip to use, and therefore how long the video is: the same number trims the audio and sets duration x fps + 1 frames. Attaching a clip sets this to its length, rounded up to the next half second. A clip shorter than this is padded and the model generates the tail.

params.label: Start (s)
params.description: Where in the clip to start. Everything before it is trimmed away.

params.label: Distilled LoRA
params.description: LTX-2.3's distilled LoRA, which is what makes these short schedules enough. Off, the checkpoint runs undistilled: lengthen the sigma lists and raise CFG above 1, or the result is mush. The file is not even opened while this is off.

params.label: Enhance the prompt
params.description: Rewrite the prompt with Gemma before encoding it. Needs the enhancer LoRA and the text encoder; off, that branch never runs.

params.label: Model
params.description: Read three times over: the diffusion model, the audio VAE and the AV text-encoder pairing all come out of this one file.

params.label: Distilled strength
params.description: How much of the distilled LoRA to apply. The official graph runs it at 0.5.

params.label: Latent upscaler
params.description: The spatial upscaler between the two sampling passes.

params.label: Sigmas (first pass)
params.description: The low-resolution pass's schedule, written out rather than built from a step count: nine sigmas are eight steps.

params.label: Sigmas (refine pass)
params.description: The refine pass's schedule, written out rather than built from a step count.
